<?php

$names = str_split('ABCDEFG');
$weights = array_fill(0, 7, array_fill(0, 7, 0));
$edges = [
    ['A', 'B', 7], ['A', 'C', 3], ['A', 'D', 9], ['B', 'C', 2], ['C', 'E', 6], ['B', 'D', 3],
    ['D', 'E', 4], ['D', 'F', 5], ['E', 'F', 3], ['E', 'G', 8], ['F', 'G', 4],
];
foreach ($edges as [$a, $b, $weight]) {
    $i = ord($a) - 65;
    $j = ord($b) - 65;
    $weights[$i][$j] = $weights[$j][$i] = $weight;
}
$distance = array_fill(0, 7, PHP_INT_MAX);
$distance[0] = 0;
$previous = array_fill(0, 7, -1);
$finalized = array_fill(0, 7, false);
for ($step = 0; $step < 7; $step++) {
    $vertex = -1;
    for ($i = 0; $i < 7; $i++) {
        if (!$finalized[$i] && ($vertex < 0 || $distance[$i] < $distance[$vertex])) {
            $vertex = $i;
        }
    }
    $finalized[$vertex] = true;
    for ($neighbor = 0; $neighbor < 7; $neighbor++) {
        $weight = $weights[$vertex][$neighbor];
        if ($weight > 0 && $distance[$vertex] + $weight < $distance[$neighbor]) {
            $distance[$neighbor] = $distance[$vertex] + $weight;
            $previous[$neighbor] = $vertex;
        }
    }
}
foreach ($names as $i => $name) {
    $path = [];
    $vertex = $i;
    while ($vertex >= 0) {
        array_unshift($path, $names[$vertex]);
        $vertex = $previous[$vertex];
    }
    printf("%s: distance=%d path=%s\n", $name, $distance[$i], implode('-', $path));
}
